title: Perfect for dementia too
body: I downloaded this for my Mum who has Alzheimer’s but wants to keep her independence. It’s great that I can put photos of her actual things into the list so it’s more meaningful and she can tick off the checklist so if she forgets where she’s at, she can check and be confident with what has been done. Real life changer for my Mum and reduced the anxiety a lot! Thank you - I’ll be recommending it :-)
